title: AI-mediated Interactive Health Messaging for Community Health Promotion in Low-Middle Income Countries.
summary: HIBA was tested with community groups in Lebanon and Jordan to improve access to understandable health information in text and audio.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: The HIBA chatbot combines retrieval, language models, speech recognition, and speech synthesis. Testing included groups of 6, 20, and 50 participants, with feedback used to refine language, usability, and content. It supports 28 languages. The source describes access and user-testing work, while improved health literacy and health decisions remain expected outcomes.
purpose: Make reliable health information more accessible across language and literacy barriers.

ratings.reason: The chatbot was tested with community groups. Improvements in health literacy, health decisions, or health have not been quantified.
Community-health support is described without an observed operational result.
Reduced misinformation and health disparities are expected effects.

ai_role.statement: The account does not isolate AI’s contribution from the surrounding workflow.

evidence.citation: International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025). Project-submitted account, current as of June 2025. ITU provides no independent outcome evaluation.
evidence.title: Use Case 10: AI-mediated Interactive Health Messaging for Community Health Promotion in Low-Middle Income Countries.

produced_by: The account does not establish conditions sufficient to reproduce the benefit.
must_hold: The account does not establish requirements for reproducing the benefit in other settings.

headline: HIBA offers multilingual health information in Lebanon and Jordan
claim_basis: Sources: the makers' report. The cited evidence includes no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
